## How to study this information

Take your time with each chapter. Read the overview first, then work through the verse groups one at a time. As you read, mark what stands out and write down your own thoughts. Your highlights and notes stay private on your device, so you can study at your own pace and return to them whenever you like.

::: {.stamp .study-box}
[Adding highlights and notes]{.box-title}

1. Select the words you want. On a phone or tablet, touch and hold a word, then drag the handles.
2. A bar appears at the bottom of the screen. Tap a color to highlight, or tap **Add note** to write your own comment.
3. Tap any highlight to change its color, edit its note, or remove it.
4. Open **My Notes** in the menu to see everything you have saved, with a link back to each passage.

[Good to know]{.box-sub}

- Highlights and notes are saved only on the device and browser you used. They do not sync to other devices, and no one else can see them.
- Clearing your browser data or deleting the app erases them. In **My Notes**, use **Save a backup** now and then, and **Restore a backup** to bring them back.
- If the wording of a passage is updated later, a highlight on that passage may no longer appear. Your text is still kept in **My Notes**.
- Safari on iPhone and iPad can erase website data after about a week without a visit. Installed apps are not affected, so installing the app is the safest way to keep your notes.

<p class="install-actions"><button type="button" id="notes-open" class="translate-btn">Open My Notes</button></p>
:::
